root.label: Gen. Dan Caine letter on military at 2026 polling places

events.label: Gen. Dan Caine letter on military at 2026 polling places

slots.name: polling deployment plans
slots.sentence: His answers, in part, read: “The Joint Force has no plans to send federal military personnel or federalized members of the National Guard to polling places during the 2026 elections … no plans to seize ballots, voting machines, or other election-related material. I have neither received nor anticipate receiving any unlawful order concerning the role of the Joint Force in the upcoming November 2026 midterm elections.”
